answer: Split each identity bond in two to stop mass fakes: half filed openly, half held privately, bound by one violet seal. Each epoch a comet sweep audits 4% of identities: show the private half in 8 min or burn the bond. First filing costs 30, the k-th 30+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 2,527,500 and lock 50,000, losing 2,577,500 on a 40,000 pool. The fable of a rented half passing dies at the seal check; an honest agent pays 30 once and keeps its bond.
